messages.text: Coordination review turned up a mismatch on the Section 26 05 33 conduit routing between Electrical Panel Schedule E-601 and Electrical Detail 2/E502 -- can you confirm which is correct before we release for fabrication? This is routine and can be worked into the normal submittal cycle. No cost impact is anticipated. No schedule impact is expected. Please respond before the panel energization walkthrough.
